children: rallied on Thursday as the restaurant showed sales progress late in the quarter as it overcame some of consumer fears over the safety of lettuce and jalapenos. The launches of Pollo Asada and Chili Lime Chips were also sales drivers during the quarter. On the conference call, CEO Scott Boatwright said the company is “very confident” about the setup for November and December. "Broader consumer and industry headwinds may continue, but initiatives across our recipe for growth strategy are building and giving us more tools to win in any environment," he noted.

The reaction from the analyst community has been mainly favorable. BNP Paribas analyst Steve McManus said the improving sales momentum and a cleaner margin setup for 2027 are encouraging as pricing catches up with inflation. BMO Capital Markets analyst Andrew Strelzik noted Chipotle
continues to demonstrate steady comp improvement from cyclical lows, and further improvements should drive multiple recovery. William Blair analyst Sharon Zackfia and her team think Chipotle

is building the layers for accelerating comparable sales and profit improvement. "Growth was broad-based across income and age cohorts, including outperformance of lower-income cohorts for the first time this year (with the greatest outperformance in September when promotional activity was lowest) and with loyalty comps outpacing reported metrics," highlighted Zackfia. TD Cowen was less positive on the Chipotle
, as analyst Andrew Charles pointed out that the chain is prioritizing traffic over margins.
